review:
A book slot for the Egyptian cat goddess Bastet, on 5x3 with 10 lines. The Golden Book is both wild and scatter.

The twist I like: during the base game, a symbol is picked at random and shown in a sixth cell, so you know which symbol will expand before the bonus even starts. Three scatters give 10 free spins with that symbol expanding across its reel. Very high volatility, an 8,202x max, an excellent 96.99% RTP, and free spins about once every 140 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 140 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
